reviews.x: GREAT!  since Dial quit making the Grapeseed soap, this is a fair replacement!  Soaps usually make my skin a little itchy, so when they discontinued the Grapeseed, I was worried, but this does not itch.  the scent is mild.

reviews.t: Cleans but Doesn't Moisturize/VERY Strong Scent
reviews.x: From the description, I thought this soap would be moisturizing...it was slightly drying. With a little moisturizer after bathing, no harm done. FYI, the scent of this soap is strong enough to smell like you have Glade scented candles throughout the house...if you can live with that, okay.

reviews.t: Great soap but a poor value for the hard earned buck
reviews.x: This is the only soap I use as it is gentle and smells divine.  I gave it only 3 stars as the price is way too high.  I bought it online because my stores do not carry it anymore.  After shelling out the extra cash, I found it for less than half of the price at Target.  Go figure.

reviews.t: This is one of the best soaps that dial has ever made
reviews.x: This is one of the best soaps that dial has ever made. Good smells great and it does not leave your skin feeling dry at all. My husband and I both use this soap. This soap is impossible to find in stores but thankfully Amazon always has it in stock

reviews.t: My favorite soap. I have perfume allergies and this I ...
reviews.x: My favorite soap. I have perfume allergies and this I can tolerate. Too many soaps today are too stinky. This one is light and pleasant. It reminds me of the old Dial soap growing up. My only complaint is the price. $13 and higher is far too much for this pack. Other scents costs less, particularly in local stores. I only buy here because so far I haven't been able to buy it locally anymore, but if that changes...
I love these glycerine soaps. I've had a hard time finding them in stores. The White tea is a nice subtle fragrance.
It's soap, what much can I really say. If used properly, you too can be clean.

reviews.t: Initial strong scent that settles down when exposed to air for a while; decent soap for harder water
reviews.x: When you open the box, the smell is a bit overwhelming. Suggest you let the individual boxes "breathe" on a porch or outside for a day or two. Then things calm down. They lather well is semi-hard water; maybe over lather in soft water. I've adjusted to them and will continue to use them, now that the odor given off is manageable. So far as I can tell, the scent is "green tea"  but the soap itself is basic Dial glycerin soap scented to smell like green tea.

I have used this soap for years.  It is especially helpful at keeping my skin moist in our dry winter months.So glad that I could find it on Amazon as it is no longer in the grocery stores in our area.
I have used this soap for years. Its scent is very nice but not strong. It does not dry out your skin. Used to buy in stores but now have to get online.
This is my soap and I can't get it at my local stores.  Love the glycerin and the clean fragrance that works for male & female.
Bought for four years and great soap, washes clean with no residue--midwest.
Exactly what we needed, and arrived in perfect condition.

reviews.t: Love this soap, the price...not so much!
reviews.x: Love this soap and have previously purchased at Target. It is no longer available at my Target store and I am so sad. This price is outlandish...will purchase until I can find it elsewhere. Come on Amazon! The fragrance may seem strong right out of the box, however after you use it, it dissipates quickly and is quite soft and lovely...very feminine. Recommendations are to not use antibacterial soaps and this is a wonderful daily shower/bath soap that does not dry your skin. I am a former redhead

I wanted a glycerine soap and am not finding one in the stores.  Thought I'd try this one.  Too bad it seems to only  be available in a bulk pack. The description claims a light scent, and although is does seem fairly light, it spreads through my entire bathroom (14 ft x 5 ft).  It has a fragrance which is not necessarily bad as long as you want the entire room it is in smelling that way.  The smell doesn't fade away as it has been this way for a couple weeks. The ingredient list on the package I got contained practically anything that could be called "soap" with the admonition that one or more of any of the listed ingredients could be in the soap. Seriously, if you aren’t already using glycerine soap then you should be. Glycerine absorbs water. It pulls moisture to your skin. Usually it is separated and used as lotion or moisturizer but you should be using it in your soap! It will help your skin absorb moisture from the air. This is some of the cheapest, best soap money can buy. Just try it.

This item is a great value for the price. I received the package today. This is the only soap that I can use without breaking out. Tide Regular Powder Is the only detergent I can use. The soap has a clean fragrance, good lather and leaves my skin clean.  I hope that I will be able to find these two products as long as I need them.;  KH

reviews.t: Yucky strong perfume smell. Other glycerin’s by dual are better!
reviews.x: Nothing wrong with the seller or experience. Product is the only problem. I like all dial glycerin soap EXCEPT this one. The smell is very “perfumery” - not expected from the description which sounds more natural and botanical. The strong  scent actually irritates the skin.

reviews.t: THIS White Tea glycerin soap is the BEST EVER!!!
reviews.x: I LOVE this Dial White tea glycerin bar, and so grateful you aren't selling the NEW Dail White Tea WHITE bar soap as  the White tea glycerin product like many other retailers are doing.  Shame on Dial Soap for the deceptive marketing on this product.

reviews.t: I can only find these on Amazon!
reviews.x: My husband gets really funky feet from his work boots & this is the only kind of soap that has ever really helped with the funk. Used ti but these for so much cheaper in stores, but now it's just on Amazon, so I pay it.

claims.text: Many reviewers love this soap and describe it as gentle, effective, and a favorite they have used for years.
A common complaint is that the soap is hard to find in local stores, so customers buy it online.
Several reviewers find the price too high, especially compared to other retailers.
Opinions on the scent are mixed: some find it mild and pleasant, while others find it strong or overpowering.
Some reviewers report the soap is drying or not moisturizing, while others say it does not dry out their skin.
